load_color_image: load a color image from a file path and return a normalized torch tensor in range 0 to 1
load_flow_tensor: load an optical flow image from a raw file path and return a 2-channel flow tensor in pixels
load_mask_tensor: load a binary mask image from a file path and return a 0 or 1 torch tensor
create_VideoDataset: create a PyTorch dataset that loads 3D video frame pairs with flow, mask, and camera metadata
create_VideoFrameDataset: create a PyTorch dataset that loads individual video frames from a formatted color file path
